subject.title: fix(cli): keep plugin help exit-clean by lazily loading node runtime

question: Should this protected CLI-exit fix require contributor-supplied real-process proof before merge, or may a maintainer explicitly override that gate after independently verifying the exact head?
rationale: The patch is narrowly targeted and has process-test coverage, but the PR lacks inspectable after-fix runtime evidence and carries the protected `maintainer` label.

options.title: Require terminal proof
options.body: Keep the proof gate and request a redacted terminal transcript or recording for root and plugin-command help exiting with code 0.

options.title: Maintainer verification override
options.body: A maintainer may waive contributor proof only after personally reproducing the two clean exits on the current PR head.

recommendation.title: Require terminal proof
recommendation.body: Keep the proof gate and request a redacted terminal transcript or recording for root and plugin-command help exiting with code 0.

likelyOwner.reason: The available context ties this contributor directly to the CLI runtime change and its stated reproduction evidence.
